name: dolt

patches.old:
echo 'Installing dolt into /usr/local/bin.'
  [ ! -d /usr/local/bin ] && install -o 0 -g 0 -d /usr/local/bin
  install -o 0 -g 0 "dolt-$PLATFORM_TUPLE/bin/dolt" /usr/local/bin
  install -o 0 -g 0 -d /usr/local/share/doc/dolt/
  install -o 0 -g 0 -m 644 "dolt-$PLATFORM_TUPLE/LICENSES" /usr/local/share/doc/dolt/

smoke: mkdir -p "$HOME/dolt-test"; cd "$HOME/dolt-test"; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/dolt" config --global --add user.name Shellferry; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/dolt" config --global --add user.email test@example.invalid; if [ ! -d .dolt ]; then "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/dolt" init; fi; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/dolt" sql -q "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sample (id INT PRIMARY KEY); REPLACE INTO sample VALUES (42); SELECT id FROM sample;" | grep -q 42
notes: Official release installer converted to ordinary-user prefix: removes root-only ownership settings and writes binary/license under the selected prefix. Original platform/dependency checks remain. Smoke initializes a local repository and executes SQL.
